scope: Offline Linux follow-up: static Windows shader research and shared-memory staging; no Windows execution or live dock integration

original_gpu_comparison.method: Five alternating original/staged binary pairs per case. Each invocation used 2-second warmups, 1-second saturation windows and 5-second paced diagnostic windows. CPU fixed at 8 workers for motion and 16 for noise. Only saturation measurements are used here; these short runs are exploratory.
original_gpu_comparison.confidence: 10,000 paired percentile bootstrap samples of log throughput ratios, Python random seed 0x76696e6f; five pairs per workload

fresh_cpu_comparison.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840U w/ Radeon 780M Graphics
fresh_cpu_comparison.energy_scope: AMD APU/SoC package, including CPU and GPU; not whole-laptop or dock power
fresh_cpu_comparison.recommendation: exploratory: full acceptance measurements are incomplete

power_conclusion: Not evaluated in this follow-up. Five-second paced samples are diagnostics only and do not replace the original 60-second energy protocol.
